q1.q: Does the agent give legal or tax advice?
q1.a: Never. It's a non-negotiable guardrail built into every agent: it qualifies the inquiry and routes it to you. All professional advice stays in your hands.

q2.q: What happens when the agent doesn't know the answer?
q2.a: When in doubt, it escalates: it tells the prospect a team member will take over and sends you a 5-line summary with the full history.

q3.q: Will my clients know they're talking to an assistant?
q3.a: Yes. The agent always discloses that an assistant is handling the initial request. Transparency protects your reputation — and it's mandatory in our configurations.

q4.a: Every exchange is logged and encrypted, every firm is isolated from the others, and no client data is used to train anything. Period.

q5.a: Diagnostic within 7 days, setup in 2 weeks — including a draft-mode period where you approve every reply before it's sent. You stay in control.

q6.q: Why start with a paid diagnostic?
q6.a: Because it gives you a number: what missed inquiries actually cost you. If an agent isn't economically justified, we'll tell you. The diagnostic is credited toward setup if you continue.

hero.title: How it works
hero.subtitle: Five steps, strict guardrails, total transparency. Here is exactly what happens when a prospect writes to your firm.

s1.title: Reception
s1.text: An inquiry arrives by email or web form. The agent reads it immediately, 24/7 — including April 14th at 11 pm.

s2.title: Language detection & reply
s2.text: The agent detects the prospect's language (French or English) and replies in that language, in your firm's tone, in under 2 minutes.

s3.title: Qualification
s3.text: It asks the essential questions of your profession: type of need, timeline, situation. Every conversation gets a qualification score from 0 to 100.

s4.title: Appointment or escalation
s4.text: Qualified prospect → slot proposed from your calendar. Complex, sensitive or uncertain case → escalated to you with a 5-line summary.

s5.title: Log & report
s5.text: Every exchange is fully logged. On the 1st of the month you receive a report: leads, appointments, response time, estimated value captured.

guardrails.title: The guardrails — non-negotiable
guardrails.subtitle: Every agent is configured with strict rules that protect your professional liability.

g1.title: Never professional advice
g1.text: The agent never gives legal, tax or insurance advice. It qualifies and routes. The advice is yours.

g2.title: Never a firm price or a promise
g2.text: No definitive quote, no promised outcome. Those conversations are escalated to you, systematically.

g3.title: Mandatory disclosure
g3.text: The agent always states that an assistant is handling the initial request. Your clients are never misled.

g4.title: Bilingual by design
g4.text: Automatic detection of the prospect's language and replies in French or English, with zero configuration on your side.

g5.title: Escalation at the slightest doubt
g5.text: If the agent isn't certain, it doesn't improvise: it escalates to you with a 5-line summary and the full history.

g6.title: Draft mode for the first 2 weeks
g6.text: At launch, no reply goes out without your approval. You approve, edit or reject every draft from your dashboard.

s1.title: Complete logging
s1.text: Every inbound and outbound message is timestamped and archived. You can audit any conversation, any time.

s2.title: Per-firm isolation
s2.text: Your data lives in a space strictly separated from other firms. No crossover possible.

s3.title: Zero training on your data
s3.text: No client data is used to train any AI model. It's contractual.

verticals.scenarioNote: Excerpt from a typical conversation. Try it yourself in the test space.

tax.name: Tax preparers
tax.title: During tax season, every silent hour costs you a file
tax.pain: From January to April, your inbox overflows. Prospects who don't get an answer within hours sign with the competitor next door. And off-season requests — ITIN, late filings, IRS letters — arrive when you're not there.

value1.title: Automatic urgency triage
value1.text: IRS letter, imminent deadline, first filing: the agent identifies the urgency and prioritizes it in your queue.

value2.title: Basic information collection
value2.text: Filing status, W-2 or 1099, state of residence: the file arrives pre-qualified at your appointment.

value3.title: Zero tax advice
value3.text: The agent never answers “how much will I get back?”. It qualifies, reassures and routes to you.

scenario.user1: Hi, I received a letter from the IRS and I don't understand what they want. Is it serious?
scenario.agent1: Hello! I'm the firm's assistant — I handle your initial request and a preparer will reply to you personally. An IRS letter always deserves a careful read, but many are simple information requests. So the firm can help you quickly: what code or subject is shown at the top of the letter, and what deadline does it mention?
scenario.user2: It says CP2000, and I have to reply before the 28th of this month.
scenario.agent2: Thank you, that's very helpful. A CP2000 with a close deadline is exactly the type of file the firm treats as a priority. I can offer you an appointment as early as tomorrow: 10:30 am or 3:00 pm — which works for you? In the meantime, don't reply to the letter yourself — just bring it to the appointment.

immigration.name: Immigration lawyers
immigration.title: Your prospects write at night, worried. Reply before the sleepless night.
immigration.pain: An immigration matter doesn't wait for office hours. The people contacting you are often anxious, sometimes facing a summons or a visa deadline. Without a fast answer, they shop around — and sign elsewhere.

value1.title: Immediate, reassuring response
value1.text: The agent acknowledges, reassures about next steps and collects the situation without ever legally assessing the case.

value2.title: Structured pre-qualification
value2.text: Type of procedure, deadlines, documents received: your consultation starts with an already-structured file.

value3.title: Zero legal advice
value3.text: No assessment of chances, no interpretation of the law. Substantive questions are escalated to you with a summary.

scenario.user1: Hello, my work visa expires in 6 weeks and my employer hasn't started the renewal. Can you help?
scenario.agent1: Hello, and thank you for reaching out. I'm the firm's assistant — I handle initial requests and an attorney will follow up personally. A 6-week window is exactly the kind of situation the firm treats as time-sensitive. May I ask: what type of visa do you currently hold, and has your employer given any indication of their plans?
scenario.user2: It's an H-1B. They say they want to keep me but HR is slow.
scenario.agent2: Understood — thank you. I won't speculate on your options; that's for the attorney to assess with you directly. Given the timeline, I'd suggest a consultation this week: Wednesday 2 pm or Thursday 11 am are available. The attorney will review renewal timing and what your employer needs to file. Which slot works best?

insurance.name: Insurance agents
insurance.title: An unanswered quote request is a policy signed elsewhere
insurance.pain: Quote requests come in at all hours, and response speed makes the sale: the first agent to answer wins the comparison. Your renewals and claims, meanwhile, demand immediate handling to keep trust.

value1.title: Speed that wins the comparison
value1.text: Reply in under 2 minutes, quote information collected, appointment proposed — while competitors sleep.

value2.title: Quote / claim / renewal triage
value2.text: The agent identifies the nature of the request and applies the right path. Claims are escalated as a priority.

value3.title: Zero firm quotes
value3.text: The agent never commits to a price or a coverage. It collects, qualifies, and leaves the proposal to you.

scenario.user1: Good evening, I just bought a car and I need insurance before Friday. Can you give me a price?
scenario.agent1: Good evening, and congratulations on your purchase! I'm the agency's assistant — I prepare your file and the agent will personally confirm the proposal. I can't quote a firm price, but I can prepare everything so you have your answer before Friday. A few questions: what's the vehicle's model and year, and have you been insured in the last 3 years?
scenario.user2: A 2022 Toyota RAV4, and yes I was insured with another agent.
scenario.agent2: Perfect, noted. With a continuous insurance history, your file is strong. The agent can call you tomorrow to finalize the proposal: morning or afternoon? Please have your driver's license and your insurance record handy.
